crates: aegis-bin (feature p2: supervisor wiring, wasm: routes, F14 decoder, response re-serialization)
spec_refs: SPEC §H I5 (host re-serializes everything a module emits; host decoder in the verified TCB)
budget gate: aegis-bin p2 adds no third-party crate; fail-closed-boot stays green
PLAN D1, D2, D7, D8, D15
oracles: oracles/p2-e2e (real binary + release worker; test-hooks worker for the respawn family)

acceptance.cmd: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/p2 ci/heavy.sh cargo build --release --locked -q -p aegis-bin --features aegis-bin/p2 -p aegis-p2 && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/p2-test ci/heavy.sh cargo build --release --locked -q -p aegis-p2 --features aegis-p2/test-hooks && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/p2-mutants ci/heavy.sh cargo build --release --locked -q -p aegis-bin --features aegis-bin/p2,aegis-bin/p2-mutants -p aegis-p2 --features aegis-p2/mutants && oracles/p2-e2e/run --subject target/p2/release/aegis --worker target/p2/release/aegis-p2 --test-worker target/p2-test/release/aegis-p2 && oracles/p2-e2e/run --self-test --subject target/p2/release/aegis --worker target/p2/release/aegis-p2 --mutant-subject target/p2-mutants/release/aegis --mutant-worker target/p2-mutants/release/aegis-p2 && ci/remote.sh cargo xtask budget
acceptance.must: PASS on the laptop; golden-build test asserts the default and p2 builds enable neither test-hooks nor mutants nor p2-mutants; budget: aegis-bin builds unchanged in third-party crate count; oracles/p2-e2e/default-subject written

notes: Route target `wasm:<module-id>`; the supervisor compiles modules at boot/reload via `aegis-p2 compile` and holds their digests; the F14 decoder caps frames and kills the worker on decode failure (charged to the principal). data_run is answered 'denied' (fail closed) until P5-bin-002.
